generic.name: Knife Round
generic.desc: Knife only. No grenades.

generic.name: Grenadier
generic.desc: Buy as many nades as possible. Must use all first before knifing.

generic.name: Hero Rifler
generic.desc: Only the topfrag can have a rifle. If they can't buy one, donate one.

generic.name: Heavy Mag
generic.desc: Can only move with 50% mag

generic.name: 2 at Banana
generic.desc: All callouts are banana

generic.name: Homerun
generic.desc: You must run back to spawn upon kill

generic.name: hacks.com
generic.desc: You must type something like "hacks.com" upon kill

generic.name: The Mechanic
generic.desc: Only the bottom fragger is allowed to reload guns; they cannot shoot until they are the last one alive; Swap mechanic if they die early

generic.name: Moonwalking
generic.desc: You can only move by holding S

generic.name: DOOM
generic.desc: You can only move with W and S

generic.name: Deathball
generic.desc: Entire team moves closely together

generic.name: Flock o birds
generic.desc: Entire team walks together and scatter when shot at; regroup when quiet

generic.name: Tag team
generic.desc: One player from your team is chosen to leave spawn; when they die choose another player

generic.name: I've been hit!
generic.desc: Say something like "I've been hit!" or "Ow" anytime you take damage

generic.name: Art Break
generic.desc: Draw a smiley face or dick at spawn before leaving

generic.name: Piloting school
generic.desc: Invert your mouse

generic.name: Counter Strike on Ice
generic.desc: Cannot stop/crouch/walk unless planting/defusing. Feel free to do a 360 jump whenever appropriate

generic.name: Non-Fungible Guns
generic.desc: Every player on their team has to buy a unique SMG/Shotgun

generic.name: Expensive Fake Flash
generic.desc: You must fake flash with your primary when rounding a corner

generic.name: Stress-induced Blindness
generic.desc: Last player alive must close their eyes/turn off their monitor. Team can direct them

generic.name: Honorbound
generic.desc: When pulling out a pistol/knife, you must get a kill before switching

generic.name: Leapfrog
generic.desc: You must leapfrog with a teammate to move unless you're the last alive/alone

generic.name: MLG Compliation
generic.desc: Buy an AWP, Scout, Shotgun, or Deagle. Do a 360 spin before every shot

generic.name: Hotline Miami
generic.desc: You must use the gun of the enemy you just killed

generic.name: Onamanapia
generic.desc: Mute your game and imitate the sounds

generic.name: Randomizer
generic.desc: Violently mash B and 1-6

generic.name: Butterfingers
generic.desc: Everytime you fire your gun you must drop it.

generic.name: The Weirding Way
generic.desc: Buy an AWP. You must yell before you shoot

generic.name: Running Scoutsman
generic.desc: Always have a Scout out; quickswitching is allowed

generic.name: Sam Fisher
generic.desc: Buy Nightvision Goggles. Press N

generic.name: Marching Fire
generic.desc: Entire team buys an M249. Hold Down M1 for the entire round except when planting or defusing.

generic.name: TTT Guns Only
generic.desc: Valid guns: Silenced USP, Glock, Five-Seven, Deagle, M4A1, M1014, Scout, M249

pistol.name: Stealth Mission
pistol.desc: Use a Silenced USP. Only smokes allowed

ct_only.name: Ninja Clan
ct_only.desc: Entire team must attempt to ninja defuse. Knife and util only

ct_only.name: Boost me!
ct_only.desc: Teammates on the same site must be boosting each other. If < 4 players, stack a site

t_only.name: Freeze Bomb
t_only.desc: You cannot move while you have the bomb
